title: First head-to-head comparison of allograft repair, direct neurorrhaphy and non-surgical management for iatrogenic trigeminal nerve injury: a prospective multicentre cohort study with doubly robust analysis
html: Trigeminal nerve injuries severely degrade quality of life, yet comparative effectiveness evidence for existing treatments is scarce. The authors prospectively followed 153 adults with iatrogenic lingual or inferior alveolar nerve injuries treated at two specialized centres in Leuven, Belgium and Chicago, USA between June 2021 and January 2025; 116 received non-surgical management, 19 underwent direct end-to-end neurorrhaphy and 18 underwent connector-assisted cadaveric allograft reconstruction.
